title: CipherGrid Season-4 Puzzle League Match
description: Terminal CipherGrid puzzle-league season-4 match. Players earn pressure-adjusted family-adjacency points on the board tape, grow combo streaks, clash on rivalry ticks, and reveal echo-dotted edges on the Graphviz board map. Match scorecard JSON matches match_scorecard; combo, rivalry, and echo rules live under semantics.

archive_layout.cells_json: cells.json with cells[] and solution map
archive_layout.glyphs_toml: glyph sections with weight and family
archive_layout.moves_jsonl: one JSON object per line: player_id, cell_id, tick
archive_layout.scorecard_md: human-readable puzzle scoring and digest rules

semantics.family_adjacency: solution glyph family of a cell; matchingNeighborCount counts orthogonal neighbors sharing that family; cellsShareFamily compares two cells
semantics.glyph_pressure: before move index i, count solution cells sharing the played cell family that do not appear among moves[0..i); pressure_factor = 1.0 + 0.05 * that count
semantics.move_points: round(base) then round(base * pressure_factor) where base = glyph_weight + 2 * matchingNeighborCount; half-away-from-zero to 2dp at each round
semantics.player_total: sum of pressure-adjusted move points in tape order, then round total to 2dp half-away-from-zero
semantics.combo_streak: per player, moves sorted by tick then cell_id; consecutive same-family plays grow streak; each continued step adds 0.25*(streak_len-1); combo_points is the rounded sum; max_streak is the longest streak observed
semantics.combo_digest: sha256 of sorted lines player_id|combo_points|max_streak with combo_points at 2dp
semantics.rivalry: for every unordered pair of moves from different players with |tick_a-tick_b|<=1, orthogonal neighbor cells, and shared solution family, add 0.5 rivalry to each player; rivalry_points rounded 2dp; rivalry_digest is sha256 of sorted player_id|rivalry_points lines
semantics.season_score_digest: sha256 of sorted lines player_id|total|move_count with total at 2dp
semantics.board_fingerprint: sha256 of sorted lines cell_id|glyph_id|family|degree where degree is neighbor count

dot_graph.name: ciphergrid
dot_graph.family_edges: dashed when cellsShareFamily on an adjacency, same orientation rule
dot_graph.echo_edges: dotted when shared family and both cell ids appear somewhere on the move tape, same orientation rule
dot_graph.layout_source: Graphviz plain layout of the board digraph supplies node x/y for layout_digest

semantics.layout_digest: sha256 of sorted name|x|y from Graphviz plain-layout node rows of digraph ciphergrid; coords at 2dp half-away-from-zero
semantics.match_chain: prior tip from /app/var/match_chain_tip.txt (empty when absent); match_chain_digest = sha256(prior|playtest_seal|rivalry_digest); tip file updated to that digest after each successful score
semantics.players_array: match scorecard players array is sorted ascending by player_id (same order as season_score_digest, combo_digest, and rivalry_digest lines)

players.description: Player score objects sorted ascending by player_id
